title: Hanasato Minori — MORE MORE JUMP!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi and Shizuku are late.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Maybe their lesson ran over time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was going to wait until everyone was here, but I guess I can show you first.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been thinking about what we'll need for our debut! Do you mind taking a look at the list I wrote?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not at all, show me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(You rarely see Minori looking so earnest.
This must be very important to her.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks! So...
Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What's this...?
A list of...catchphrases?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You've got to have your signature catchphrases worked out, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I...suppose so?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's not what I was expecting, but that's the sort of thing Minori would come up with...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wrote catchphrases for everyone in our group. I'll start with mine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just an audition regular no more!
This yet-to-debut idol will move mountains to graduate into a full-fledged celeb!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just an audition regular no more!
This yet-to-debut idol—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No need to repeat, I heard you fine the first time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This catchphrase conveys your personality very well but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's just it won't work after you've debuted, see? Wouldn't it be better to come up with something you can keep using, make it your thing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... Yes, you're absolutly right!
Why didn't I think of that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll see if I can come up with something that can stick for longer!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, let's move on to the catchphrase I wrote for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The resplendent Haruka is the brightest star in this universe!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think? Do you like it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see where you were going with it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But resplendent and brightest star, that's a bit too much, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, maybe, yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But maybe adding even more shiny imagery to it would make it more memorable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The dazzling, resplendent Haruka is the shiniest, brightest star illuminating this universe! Twinkle-twinkle!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That... That is memorable, but it doesn't say much about me, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... It takes more than to say you're our brilliant star to express your appeal, huh.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright then! I'll have a think about a better catchphrase for you, which will convey all your amazing qualities!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just make sure it doesn't get too long.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And what did you come up with for Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi's is this. Energy blast!
The silly-cute, mega expressive idol, cool on the outside, mellow on the inside!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Er... That's very spot on, but you realize she'd get mad if she heard that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? But I really worked hard on this one, and I'd like to show it to her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How about... Before you reveal this one to her, ask her what she'd like to put in her catchphrase, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She might already have one, you never know.
You wouldn't want to push your ideas onto her, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Gosh, no, of course not!
It's incredible how you think of everything, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... But then I might also need to rethink Shizuku's.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What did you write for her?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shrouded in an air of mystery, here comes the ultimate ditzy lady totally obsessed with her younger sister!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's an apt description of Shizuku, but I don't think it's flattering for an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I can see that now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you know, it may depend on the situation! I've got lots of alternatives, too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can I take a look?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! For example, I have this one for you too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... Personally, I like it, but Airi would say it doesn't have idol vibes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... Then what about this one?
It has a nice rhythm to it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's this... Five syllables, followed by seven and five again? That's a haiku poem...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Genius, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You know, you inspired me to try to come up with some catchphrases of my own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! I did?! That's great!
Let's write some more together!
